title: Where Wanxiang Weaves Life

outfit_card.silhouette: Floor-length flowing Dunhuang-inspired hanfu robe featuring an asymmetrical draped silhouette, voluminous dramatic trailing sleeves, an exposed shoulder, and an ornate, cinched bead-encrusted waistband.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Intricate filigree floral tiaras, dangling jade bead tassel hairpins, jeweled crescent-moon ornaments, and winding gold branches set with iridescent purple and teal enamel blossoms.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Embroidered halter-style du-dou camisole under an off-shoulder midnight teal flowing robe, accented by oversized bell sleeves lined in crimson and lavishly bordered with gilded brocade and jade crescent charms.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Multi-layered high-slit gradient maxi skirt transitioning from teal to deep violet, detailed with shimmering star-dusted lamé, intricate celestial embroidery hems, cascading pearl sashes, and silk petticoat layers.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating diaphanous silk ribbons, ethereal glowing mask motifs, delicate jade pendant chains, crescent moons, and theatrical lantern-lit ambiance.
